data.content_ref: inline:The target's claim and mechanism address only the first refusal (lease-mismatch with typed code before provider call) and provide no forbidden case or mechanism for the second required refusal — a school-to-seat binding whose endpoint identity disagrees with the frozen seat must not be counted as coverage. The problem explicitly requires the skeleton to cover both untested refusals with explicit forbidden cases. The mechanism only mutates 'the endpoint identity comparison to ignore drift' for the lease-mismatch assertion, with no causal link to how coverage accounting for seat bindings is tested or forbidden. Omitting an entire required refusal case is a structural failure of the problem as stated.
